newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines agrees 11.7 bln peso power project.
newsitem.headline: Philippines agrees 11.7 bln peso power project.

text.p: The Philippine Board of Investments said on Monday it had approved the construction of a 11.7 billion peso gas-fired power plant by First Gas Power Corp in the northern Philippines.
First Gas Power Corp is jointly owned by First Gas Holdings Corp, British Gas Plc and Meralco Pension Plan.
First Gas Holdings Corp is a joint venture between First Philippine Holdings Corp and British Gas.
The 500-megawatt power plant will source its power using natural gas from either the Camago/Malampaya gas field in the central Philippines or from imported liquefied natural gas.
The first phase of the plant is expected to begin commercial operation in October 2001.
Projects approved by the Board of Investments are eligible for tax and tariff incentives.
